sentence: 'Although it rained all day,' is a ______ clause that concedes a point before the main argument. (concede)
explanation: We need an adjective to modify 'clause'. The suffix -ive forms the adjective 'concessive' from the stem 'concess-' of 'concede'. Note that the stem changes from 'concede' to 'concess-', so the -ive form cannot be built by simply adding a suffix to the verb.
